html: II. ניר (√ of foll.; cf. NH נִיר, Arabic نِيرٌ, Syriac ܢܺܝܪ (in Lexx), all = the system of heddles or ‘apparatus [of small cords with loops, or eyes] by wh. the threads of the warp are raised and lowered to make an opening for the passing of the woof’ GFMPAOS Oct. 1889, clxxix. f.; cf. Assyrian nîru, Syriac ܢܺܝܪ, yoke).
